function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH aug_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(fx_rate) AS fx_rate
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
  WHERE currency = 'USD' AND period = '2026-08'
),
sep_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(fx_rate) AS fx_rate
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
  WHERE currency = 'USD' AND period = '2026-09'
)
SELECT
  pl.vendor_id,
  v.vendor_name,
  SUM(pl.qty * pl.unit_price_orig * (sep_avg.fx_rate - aug_avg.fx_rate)) AS fx_effect_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON pl.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
CROSS JOIN aug_avg
CROSS JOIN sep_avg
WHERE pl.currency = 'USD' AND pl.period = '2026-09'
GROUP BY pl.vendor_id, v.vendor_name
ORDER BY fx_effect_cad DESC
LIMIT 5","purpose":"Top vendors contributing to FX effect on September USD purchase lines"}
